gloss: points to reflect on; areas for improvement

definitions.gloss: points for reflection; areas needing improvement
definitions.explanation: Aspects of one's own conduct or a project that should be reconsidered and done better. From {反省|はんせい} (self-reflection) plus {点|てん} (point).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反省点|はんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: To list the points for improvement this time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反省点|はんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed what to improve from the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{反省点|はんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かしたい。
examples.english: I want to apply this year's lessons to next year.

notes:
From ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ (self-reflection) plus ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point). Refers to things one did poorly and wants to do better, often raised in meetings or reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反省点|はんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to list points for improvement
- {反省点|はんせいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have many things to improve
- {反省点|はんせいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かす: to apply the lessons next time

USAGE:
Less about blame than about constructive review — closer to 'lessons learned' than 'mistakes'.
